claims.claim: The cabinet matches the requested size, parts, names, and articulation.
claims.evidence: readings.json reports size_cm [40.2, 43.4, 25.6], links base, drawer, drawer_handle, and drawer_slide prismatic along +X with limits [0, 0.245] m. asset/asset.json declares articulated kind and drawer_opening on tray_floor. asset/model.urdf contains four short legs and the tray floor, back, two sides, and front panel. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png, and iso.png show the requested single-drawer cabinet with knob and plain primitive detail.

claims.claim: Collision geometry matches the visual model and preserves the open tray interior.
claims.evidence: probes/02_geometry.out verifies identical visual and collision origins and geometry for all 16 primitives, including the spherical knob. readings.json lists no collision meshes. Tray inner Y spans [-0.1736, 0.1736] m; floor top is Z=0.0994 m and rim top Z=0.175 m. There is no collision solid filling this interior.

claims.claim: The drawer opens and closes over its full range without material interpenetration and remains held at full travel.
claims.evidence: probes/01_operation.out records a loaded close/reopen cycle through intermediate positions with no overlaps above 0.0001 m, closed released q approximately 0 and full-open released q=0.245000064 m. The servo briefly overshoots closed by 0.000106 m before settling. SWEEP checks 246 positions from 0 to 0.245 m with no interpenetrations above 0.0001 m. FULL_OPEN_BOUNDS gives tray X=[0.1365, 0.4025] m against carcass X=[-0.1575, 0.1575] m: 0.021 m overlap, satisfying the specified joint-supported retention rule. Tray side clearance is 0.0154 m and floor-to-bottom-panel clearance is 0.0084 m throughout translation; these fixed transverse clearances also support the sweep result between samples.

claims.claim: The handle neck is accessible to the specified gripper from above and can transmit the drawer pull.
claims.evidence: readings.json handles identifies the neck center at [0.1876, 0, 0.14875] m; asset/model.urdf fixes drawer_handle to drawer. probes/02_geometry.out establishes neck width 0.0126 m versus 0.08 m opening, with 0.02 m fingers occupying X=[0.1776, 0.1976] m. This clears the front panel by 0.0075 m, the knob bounding extent by 0.0054 m, and the overhead top panel by 0.0131 m. The 0.035 m diameter knob is wider than the neck and provides a pull stop. Drawer translation preserves or increases approach clearance. The simulator drive in probes/01_operation.out confirms the joint can be pulled through its range; gripper access is assessed geometrically.

claims.claim: A requested 5 cm, 0.1 kg cube settles on drawer_opening inside the rim and remains inside during closing and reopening.
claims.evidence: probes/01_operation.py drops a 0.05 m cube at the prescribed full-open X=0.1575+0.245/2=0.2800 m, Y=0. probes/01_operation.out PLACED reports center [0.2800, 0, 0.12434] m after 120 frames, placing its bottom within 0.00006 m of tray_floor top 0.0994 m, with four drawer contacts totaling 0.980 N. The cube remains at Z=0.12434 m through closing and reopening; closed center X=0.03499 m is inside the tray. FINAL after another 120 frames reports the same full-open cube position and support force. Cube top Z=0.14934 m remains below rim Z=0.175 m and carcass ceiling Z=0.2275 m.

claims.claim: The rigid-object ground-settling requirement is not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies a library fixture loaded fixed on a table, and asset/asset.json kind is articulated. The operation probe uses the prescribed fixed fixture configuration. This is not a free rigid object required to settle upright.
